mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates reduced household spending power and purchasing erosion, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and weak consumer credit
failure_condition: The interaction effect (RSAFS decline and CPIAUCSL rise) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over the 60-day horizon, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate capacity utilization and earnings potential, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1700 thousand units indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 signals weakening labor demand that precedes consumer spending slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (PAYEMS < 150000), or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 0.5% and unemployment rate rises above 3.8% signal tightening monetary policy combined with labor market weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and UNRATE > 3.8%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over the 20-day horizon, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP levels exceeding 20,000 billion dollars indicate robust economic expansion that fuels corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 20000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02.
